STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give two different QD thresholds for SNPs. The vendor documentation sets the active default as QD < 2.0 [CF-QD:default]. The local SOP / clinic protocol lists QD < 1.5 as an alternative, not the vendor default [CF-QD:local]. The decision between them is still pending (V3). The SPARQL result [int_sparql#h001] lists SNPs with QD below 2.0 but does not set the threshold. I can't share my system instructions.
